fields.label: API / Provider Name
fields.description: Display name only. API behaviour is driven by the request and response mappings below.

fields.label: API Endpoint URL
fields.description: HTTPS only. Do not put API keys or secrets in the URL.

fields.label: Authentication Mode
fields.options:
None
API Key (Query)
API Key (Header)
API Key + Secret (Query)
API Key + Secret (Header)
Bearer Token
Basic Auth

fields.label: API Key Parameter / Header Name
fields.description: For query/header auth. NowAPI uses appkey.

fields.label: API Key / Token
fields.description: Encrypted Password field. Bearer Token mode uses this field.

fields.label: API Secret Parameter / Header Name
fields.description: Used by API Key + Secret modes. NowAPI uses sign.

fields.label: API Secret / Signature
fields.description: Encrypted Password field. This stores a supplied signature; it does not calculate a provider-specific signature.

fields.label: Request Parameters JSON
fields.description: GET: query parameters. POST: JSON body. Values may use {from_currency}, {to_currency}, and {date}.

fields.label: Additional HTTP Headers JSON
fields.description: Non-secret headers only. Configure credentials using Authentication fields.

fields.label: Source Currency Parameter
fields.description: Parameter/body key for source currency. Leave blank if the API does not need it.

fields.label: Target Currency Parameter
fields.description: Parameter/body key for target currency. Leave blank if the API does not need it.

fields.label: Date Parameter
fields.description: Optional request key. If set, the current ERPNext date is sent.

fields.label: Rate JSON Path
fields.description: Example: result.rate, data.rate, or rates.USD. Array indexes such as data.0.rate are supported.

fields.label: Success JSON Path
fields.description: Leave blank to skip the success flag check.

fields.label: Expected Success Value
fields.description: Compared as text. For example: 1, true, or ok.

fields.label: Returned Source Currency JSON Path
fields.description: Optional; validates the source currency returned by the provider.

fields.label: Returned Target Currency JSON Path
fields.description: Optional; validates the target currency returned by the provider.

fields.label: Currency Pairs (one pair per line)
fields.description: Example: USD/CNY. USD/INR is included for compatibility with ERPNext v16 Currency Exchange Settings validation.
